description.value: Tang Vietnamese Restaurant & Bar is an upscale evolution of the long-running Pho99, founded in 2008, blending traditional Vietnamese street food from the north, middle, and south of Vietnam with cocktails, desserts, and occasional live entertainment. The menu spans pho, rice dishes, hot pot, and Saigon-style street food, with a dedicated vegetarian section and a bar program. It operates seven days a week and bills itself as a gathering spot for family meals, date nights, and celebrations in Richmond.
